survey: A stone park chess table with two stone stools on grass. The table has a thick square slab top with a chamfered rim. A checkerboard is inset flush in the top surface, framed by the stone border. The top rests squarely on a tapered, faceted pedestal that flares out where it meets the slab. The pedestal stands on a wider stepped square plinth, and the plinth sits flat on the grass. Each stool is a round seat on a short faceted column with a round base, and both stand on the ground. The table is seen from a high three-quarter angle, with one stool on each side facing the board. Everything is solid and sits directly on what it rests on. There are no cables, hinges or loose parts.
